answer: Pinewood Federal Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm the payoff with them electronically at your appointment and send the payoff the same day. You won't need a payoff letter, just your loan account number. You receive whatever is left after the loan payoff, minus the $99 home pickup fee, by bank draft or direct deposit (direct deposit arrives in 1 to 3 business days). Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff, and if they receive an extra payment, they refund it directly to you.
